t: This is Highgate School, formally Sir Roger Cholmeley's School at Highgate, a co-educational private day school founded in 1565. Sir Roger Cholmeley, who gave the school its name, was an English judge. He had been Recorder of London and sat in the House of Commons, and he served as Lord Chief Justice of the King's Bench for a year. He's best remembered for the endowment that founded a free grammar school here. Today the school educates over 1,400 pupils, and its charity also supports other schools across London.
